sample_unit: chatbot-generated abstracts and references across 7 ophthalmology subspecialties

links.outcome: Rate of nonverifiable (hallucinated) references generated by chatbot versions
links.effect: Mean hallucination rates for nonverifiable references were 33% for the earlier and 29% for the updated version (P = .74).
links.quote: The mean hallucination rates for nonverifiable references generated by the earlier and updated versions were 33% and 29% (P = .74).

links.outcome: Fabricated references in AI-generated scientific text
links.effect: High hallucination rate of fake references (33% earlier, 29% updated version); caution advised for academic use.
links.quote: There was a high hallucination rate of generating fake references, and caution should be used when using these AI resources for health education or academic purposes.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmarking study evaluating the factual accuracy, hallucinated references, and quality of ophthalmic scientific abstracts generated by two versions of ChatGPT.
